entries.name: Secret Episode
entries.summary: Clear Final Episode; additional requirements depend on difficulty
entries.instructions: Final Mix: Beginner requires all three 140-point albums plus Keyslinger, In the Munny and Power Walker. Standard requires all albums plus Keyslinger. Proud requires all albums. This is BBS’s Secret Episode, not the standalone 0.2 game.
